author: eyo85
quote: The only good thing about this game is the free roaming. The open world looks fantastic, the graphics are impressive, and exploring the city is genuinely enjoyable.Unfortunately, everything else is a disappointment. Instead of delivering an entertaining story with interesting characters, the game feels obsessed with pushing a woke feminist agenda. The male characters are constantly portrayed as weak, submissive, and completely lacking **** gameplay and story feel more like a lecture about modern relationships than an actual GTA experience.Great open world, wasted potential, and a terribly written story.
